passives.text:
Always Active: Begin Encounters with 6 [Bullet - Solitude]
At 1+ [Bullet - Solitude], if the enemy has less than -40 SP or is Staggered at this unit or an ally's Attack End, use 'Bang. Bang.' as an Unopposed Attack (once per turn)
Attack End: At 0 [Bullet - Solitude], use 'Stories that Never Cease' as an Unopposed Attack against the target and consume 10 SP to [Reload]

Gain 1 [Petals] if the enemy takes [Sinking] damage
Gain [Petals] equal to [Faint Aroma] inflicted every time enemies gain [Faint Aroma]
Gain 2 [Petals] every time [Tremor Burst] is triggered regardless of the unit
Attack Skill End: At 30+ [Petals], use 'Magnificent End' against the target that has the highest [Faint Aroma] Stack
Deal +([Faint Aroma] on the target)% damage against Staggered targets
If this unit lost 10%+ HP this turn, heal 3% HP and 10 SP (once per turn)

Gain 1 [Petals] if the enemy takes [Sinking] damage
Gain [Petals] equal to [Faint Aroma] inflicted every time enemies gain [Faint Aroma]
Gain 2 [Petals] every time [Tremor Burst] is triggered regardless of the unit

When the ally with the fastest Speed hits an enemy using a Skill that inflicts [Sinking] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Sinking', inflict 2 [Tremor] and trigger [Tremor Burst]; then, reduce target's [Tremor] Count by 1 (once per turn)
